name: EIG
recent: EIG 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日召开第 29 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过。随后在 11 月 13 日，数名董事发出在闭锁期内交易公司证券的意向通知，闭锁期是为公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的第二季度业绩而设。近期没有新闻报导。
notable: 第 29 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 29 日举行，所有决议均获通过，包括重选董事及批准董事酬金。
数名董事发出在闭锁期内交易公司证券的意向通知，闭锁期是为公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止的第二季度业绩而设。
risks: 董事在闭锁期内发出交易意向通知，可能涉及在业绩公布前买卖公司证券。

ann.title: DEALINGS IN LISTED SECURITIES (CHAPTER 14 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : Intention to Deal During Closed Period
Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: EIG held its 29th Annual General Meeting on 29 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by shareholders. Subsequently, on 13 November 2026, several directors gave notice of their intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period pending the announcement of its second quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026. There were no recent news reports.
notable_en: The 29th Annual General Meeting was held on 29 September 2026, and all resolutions were passed, including the re-election of directors and approval of directors' remuneration.

Several directors gave notice of their intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period pending the announcement of its second quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Directors have given notice of intention to deal during the closed period, which may involve buying or selling company securities before the results announcement.
